Definition: Jashobam, the name of two or three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jashobeam is the name of two of David's mighty men, the Hachmonite who was chief of the captains and lifted his spear against three hundred at one time, and the Korhite who joined David at Ziklag. The King James spells the name Jashobeam, and the two men share it across the lists of the thirty.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God honours the mighty man who stands with David, and Jashobeam's spear is remembered because his loyalty was.
RelatedPeople: Jashobeam, Son of Zabdiel; Jashobeam the Korhite
